items.stem: During a complex program, leadership questions whether the chosen solution is still delivering expected value. Which BABOK knowledge area most directly addresses this?

options.rationale: Correct: Solution Evaluation assesses solution performance and value delivered, and recommends actions to increase value.
That area gathers information and manages stakeholders, not value assessment of a deployed solution.
Planning and monitoring governs BA work, not solution value realization.
RLCM manages requirements over time, not solution performance evaluation.

items.stem: A BA must choose between several high-level solution approaches for a transformation. Which activity compares them against business value and constraints?

options.rationale: Correct: design options are defined and evaluated against value, constraints and feasibility.
Confirming elicitation validates gathered information, not solution option comparison.
Traceability links requirements; it does not itself compare solution approaches.
A RACI clarifies responsibilities, not the comparison of solution options.

items.stem: Which TWO are purposes of business analysis governance in a large initiative? (Select TWO)

options.text: Defining how requirements changes are approved and prioritized
options.rationale: Correct: governance sets the decision and change-control process.

options.text: Establishing who has decision authority over BA information
options.rationale: Correct: governance identifies decision-makers and approval authority.
Coding is a development activity, not BA governance.
Facilities procurement is unrelated to BA governance.
Payroll administration is not part of BA governance.
